source.name: Footy Headlines
source.quote: All three kits feature long-standing main partner Banca Popolare Frusinate across the chest.
source.note: Also visible across the chest of the club's own product photos of the 2026-27 home shirt (https://store.frosinonecalcio.com/product/maglia-gara-home-26-27-gialla/).

source.name: Ciociaria Oggi: Dem Supermercati porta i bambini di "Peter Pan OdV" allo stadio
source.quote: La collaborazione con il Frosinone Calcio, essendo Dem Supermercati Back Sponsor del club, ha reso possibile trasformare una semplice partita in un’esperienza indimenticabile.
source.note: Dem's own sponsor page (https://www.supermercatidem.com/chi-siamo/valori/territorio/sponsorizzazioni/) calls Dem 'Back Sponsor Ufficiale' and says its brand is 'visibile sul retro delle maglie ufficiali'; the club's official store photo of the 2026-27 home shirt shows the Dem logo on the lower back (https://store.frosinonecalcio.com/product/maglia-gara-home-26-27-gialla/).

source.name: Eni press release: Enilive becomes Serie A Title sponsor with sponsorship agreement up until 2027
source.quote: Enilive, Eni's company dedicated to mobility products and services, will be the Title sponsor of Serie A starting from the 2024/25 championship and covering three seasons.
source.note: League title sponsor whose branding is on the official Serie A sleeve patch (same treatment as Bologna's 2026-27 kit); a sleeve patch is visible on the left sleeve of the launch photos in the Footy Headlines gallery. Not a direct club deal: see data/deals/serie-a-enilive.json.

source.name: Footy Headlines
source.quote: Italian side Frosinone Calcio and technical partner Zeus have officially unveiled the club's new home, away, and third kits for the 26-27 season.
source.note: Kit maker. Zeus's own company page (https://www.zeusport.it/en/azienda.html) lists Frosinone Calcio among the teams it dresses, and the Zeus logo is on the right chest of the club's official product photos.

summary: Zeus-made home shirt: Banca Popolare del Frusinate across the chest, Dem Supermercati on the lower back and the Serie A (Enilive) patch on the sleeve. No sleeve or shorts sponsor.
